help:
usage: gnd review panel-light [-h] --out OUT
                              [--reviewer-timeout REVIEWER_TIMEOUT]
                              [--overall-timeout OVERALL_TIMEOUT]
                              [--max-output-bytes MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES]
                              [--effort {high,medium}]
                              request

Run the same bounded six-reviewer advisory panel and publish the same
immutable evidence as `gnd review panel`, but request a lighter supported per-
run effort from Claude and Codex. The default is high; --effort medium is the
only alternative. Qwen uses persistent effort configuration, and Gemini, Kimi,
and the GLM seat expose no per-run effort flag, so their invocation policies
and models are unchanged. All request, quorum, deadline, evidence, exit-band,
and no-sandbox rules are identical to the quality-first panel.

positional arguments:
  request               repository-relative path to the review request JSON
                        (kind plan, experiment-outcome, or spec-results-
                        delta), resolved against the current directory

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --out OUT             directory to publish immutable panel evidence into; it
                        must not exist
  --reviewer-timeout REVIEWER_TIMEOUT
                        positive finite per-reviewer wall-clock bound in
                        seconds (default: 600)
  --overall-timeout OVERALL_TIMEOUT
                        positive finite whole-panel wall-clock bound in
                        seconds (default: 900)
  --max-output-bytes MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES
                        positive retained byte cap per reviewer stream; the
                        whole-panel aggregate is twice this value (default:
                        536870912 -- effectively uncapped; pass a smaller
                        value to bound a run)
  --effort {high,medium}
                        supported per-run effort for Claude and Codex
                        (default: high)
